@tct.multi-selector.selected.description: Text on the closed trigger of a MultiSelector that shows the number of chosen options (the count display). Short: it sits on the button face; `{count}` is at least 1.

@tct.multi-selector.moreCount.description: Text after the visible labels or badges on the closed trigger of a MultiSelector when more options are chosen than are shown; `{count}` is how many are hidden. Very short.
